name: GitHub Copilot
tagline: GitHub’s AI pair-programmer, now with an agent mode that turns issues into pull requests — deep IDE + GitHub integration. Free tier, Pro from $10/month.
verdict: GitHub Copilot is the safest choice for a team that already lives inside GitHub and needs AI coding rolled out at enterprise scale. Its coding agent turns a GitHub issue into a reviewable pull request natively, and its org-level policy, content-exclusion and data-handling controls are more mature than most competitors offer. It is deliberately less aggressive than dedicated agents like Cursor or Devin, a better fit for teams that want reviewable, incremental automation than a fully autonomous coder. Outside the GitHub-plus-supported-IDE stack, the advantage narrows fast.
